From 88ebadbf0deefdaccdab868b44ff70a0a257f473 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Wolfram Sang <wsa+renesas@sang-engineering.com>
Date: Fri, 17 Apr 2026 09:42:34 +0200
Subject: [PATCH] mailbox: mailbox-test: don't free the reused channel

The RX channel can be aliased to the TX channel if it has a different
MMIO. This special case needs to be handled when freeing the channels
otherwise a double-free occurs.

Fixes: 8ea4484d0c2b ("mailbox: Add generic mechanism for testing Mailbox Controllers")
Signed-off-by: Wolfram Sang <wsa+renesas@sang-engineering.com>
Signed-off-by: Jassi Brar <jassisinghbrar@gmail.com>

diff --git a/drivers/mailbox/mailbox-test.c b/drivers/mailbox/mailbox-test.c
index daf4b6f27d11..0a56b593fcac 100644
--- a/drivers/mailbox/mailbox-test.c
+++ b/drivers/mailbox/mailbox-test.c
@@ -427,7 +427,7 @@ static int mbox_test_probe(struct platform_device *pdev)
 err_free_chans:
 	if (tdev->tx_channel)
 		mbox_free_channel(tdev->tx_channel);
-	if (tdev->rx_channel)
+	if (tdev->rx_channel && tdev->rx_channel != tdev->tx_channel)
 		mbox_free_channel(tdev->rx_channel);
 	return ret;
 }
@@ -440,7 +440,7 @@ static void mbox_test_remove(struct platform_device *pdev)
 
 	if (tdev->tx_channel)
 		mbox_free_channel(tdev->tx_channel);
-	if (tdev->rx_channel)
+	if (tdev->rx_channel && tdev->rx_channel != tdev->tx_channel)
 		mbox_free_channel(tdev->rx_channel);
 }
 
-- 
2.34.1

The patch modifies the file `drivers/mailbox/mailbox-test.c`. It addresses a double-free issue that occurs when the RX channel is aliased to the TX channel.

**Modifications in `mbox_test_probe` (error path):**  
Changed the condition for freeing the RX channel from `if (tdev->rx_channel)` to `if (tdev->rx_channel && tdev->rx_channel != tdev->tx_channel)`. This prevents freeing the same channel twice in case the RX channel is the same pointer as the TX channel.

**Modifications in `mbox_test_remove` (normal removal):**  
Applied the identical condition change (`if (tdev->rx_channel && tdev->rx_channel != tdev->tx_channel)`) to avoid the same double-free during device removal.

**Relationship:**  
Both changes protect against the same scenario—whether during probe error cleanup or during normal removal, the RX channel should only be freed if it is distinct from the TX channel. The fix ensures consistency across both code paths.
